initial_decision.brief_rationale: Please retrieve archived design record R138-2. The population table and numerical verification establish the computed contrast, but do not establish whether adjustment for Z identifies the average causal risk difference.

final_decision.brief_rationale: R138-2 establishes conditional exchangeability, consistency, no interference, and positivity, identifying the causal effect by standardizing over Z. Both strata have population weight 0.5. Their risk differences are 0.9−0.9=0 and 0.6−0.8=−0.2, yielding an average causal risk difference of −0.1.
